Based on the healthcare Q&A matches, here's a synthesized answer to the user's question:

Celiac disease symptoms include diarrhea, bloating, gas, fatigue, weight loss, anemia, bone or joint pain, skin rash, headaches, and in children, failure to thrive. Some people may experience neurological or other systemic symptoms without digestive symptoms. These can manifest as fever, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and swelling, and dark urine, among others. It's essential to note that not everyone with celiac disease will exhibit all of these symptoms, but if you're experiencing any of them, it's crucial to consult a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and treatment.
